articulation.label: sit
articulation.alt: sit: /s/ → /ɪ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: pin
articulation.alt: pin: /p/ → /ɪ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: tin
articulation.alt: tin: /t/ → /ɪ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: lip
articulation.alt: lip: /l/ → /ɪ/ → /p/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
